text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few weeks had passed since the start of 
summer training camp. 
During the day, just like the other girls, 
she pushed through intensive training 
sessions—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
All our gear has been packed away. 
Shall we head out, then?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll go grab the raft!
Yeah, I'll go grab the raft!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what are those two doing...? 
Are they rowing a raft out into the 
water?! 
Are they gonna be okay?!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't worry, they're fine. Didn't you 
hear the briefing? 
Apparently those two are doing survival 
training a little ways off.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Survi... wait, what?! Why?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! 
Your rowing pace is dropping—are you 
alright?
choice_data_list: I-I'm fine...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Just a little further! Hang in there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—And so, rowing our handmade raft, 
we arrived at the campsite. Aside from 
scheduled camp drills, 
all our time was to be spent here.
choice_data_list:
(My arms are completely shot from all that 
rowing...!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aside from emergency communications, no 
modern conveniences were brought along. 
Food, shelter... everything had to be 
self-sufficient.
choice_data_list:
(Honestly, I'm still not used to this at 
all, but...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Um, regarding dinner for tonight... 
would seafood be alright with you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I actually spotted a striped beakfish 
while diving earlier. 
It seems to be hiding in the rocky reefs 
around here.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I think I can spear it, 
so I'll go catch it for us!
choice_data_list: (Tact is so full of life right now...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Clearly, she was happiest when living 
freely in the embrace of nature. 
Longing to share in that resilience, I 
mustered up my courage—
choice_data_list:
Alright, let me try catching the beakfish 
too!

Alright, let me try catching the beakfish 
too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind at all, but... 
even though striped beakfish are curious 
creatures, 
spearing one is quite a challenge.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention we'll be free-diving, 
so it will be physically demanding as 
well.
choice_data_list: Even so, I want to give it a shot!
Even so, I want to give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Of course. 
Then let's do this together!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To make our meal taste even better, 
we should get some training in first. 
What shall we do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Here, we honed Daring Tact's strengths 
using nature as our guide. 
What I had planned for today was—
choice_data_list: Charging through the waves on the raft!
Climbing the crumbling sand dunes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The waves shift constantly. By reading 
their resistance 
and propelling the raft forward, she could 
train 
her overall muscular balance.
choice_data_list:
Let's look for a spot where the swells are 
higher.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... nrggghhh...!! 
—No good, it's pushing us back...!
choice_data_list: Hold on! I'll help you—
Hold on! I'll help you—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (KASPLAAASH!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Pffhaah...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... 
you got completely soaked too, didn't you?
choice_data_list: I wasn't much help at all, was I...
I wasn't much help at all, was I...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Thanks to you, 
we were actually making a bit of forward 
progress right at the end!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've grasped when and how to 
exert power now. Next time, more 
efficiently—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah. 
...Hehe.
choice_data_list: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. Trainer... your hair, 
it's turned into a total disaster...
choice_data_list: Wait...! How embarrassing!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Daring Tact and I 
continued pushing forward with our 
survival training—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In this area, fine, powdery sand covered a 
slope 
stretching up from the beach... We had 
confirmed 
that this incline was extraordinarily 
treacherous to climb.
choice_data_list:
This is going to test your perseverance to 
keep charging up.

This is going to test your perseverance to 
keep charging up.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll give it everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—All I have to do is climb up this slope, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Here I go, then! 
Hyaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I-I slipped right back down. 
The sand is just so loose...!
choice_data_list: Dig your heels in and push through!
Dig your heels in and push through!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Right...!  
—Yaaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...............Whew. 
One more time!
choice_data_list:
...Alright, let me try too so I can find 
the trick to it!

...Alright, let me try too so I can find 
the trick to it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Let's go together, then! Ready, set— 
—Hyaaaaaah...!!
choice_data_list:
Oooohhhhh...!! (Sliding right back 
down...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Daring Tact and I 
continued pushing forward with our 
survival training—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—The rocky area where I saw the beakfish 
should be right around here.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Please be careful not to carelessly reach 
out with your hands. 
These fish... they will bite.
choice_data_list: U-Understood... Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Blub blub blub............)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact swam ahead and pointed into 
the depths... 
Right there swam the striped beakfish!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without breaking a sweat, she speared a 
striped beakfish 
that had swum close by. Realizing it was 
my turn next, 
I scanned our surroundings, and—
choice_data_list: (There...!!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact glanced over and nodded. 
Taking that as encouragement, I took aim—
choice_data_list: (Whoa, it's heading right this way...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Don't panic. 
Fish are extremely perceptive creatures.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Stay calm and wait for the perfect moment 
to strike. Hold still in the water... and 
strike!
choice_data_list: Right, I'll give it a shot...!
Yeah, I'll give it a shot...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You'll be fine, Trainer. You can do this. 
Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, guided by Daring Tact's advice, 
I kept trying again and again. 
After missing repeatedly with the spear, 
at long last—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: All right... there we go.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the fire is ready. 
Please set up the skewered beakfish over 
here. 
—Both of them!
choice_data_list: You got it!
Coming right up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Along with the beakfish we'd safely 
caught, we also managed 
to snag a few smaller fish to skewer 
alongside them. 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is delicious. 
How is the beakfish?
choice_data_list: It's incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Saltwater fish are so much more 
satisfying than freshwater fish... What a 
feast♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Besides... fish you catch with your own 
two hands 
tastes so much better.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You never gave up, Trainer, trying again 
and again... I'm so glad your hard work 
paid off.
choice_data_list: (I feel like... I've grown stronger!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After finishing up all the cleanup, we sat 
in peaceful silence around the campfire—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Um, there's something I wanted to ask...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Why did you choose to take on all these 
different challenges with me this time?
choice_data_list:
...Because I wanted to become strong, like 
you.

...Because I wanted to become strong, like 
you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Huh... Like me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I confessed my honest feelings to her. 
How facing the monumental feat of the 
Triple Tiara 
had weighed on me with a touch of 
pressure—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Yet seeing Daring Tact herself completely 
unfazed, 
charging proudly ahead toward victory...
choice_data_list: Gave me so much encouragement.
Gave me so much encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small ember popped within the glowing 
coals. 
Glancing around into the dark night— 
that gentle fire was the only light in 
sight.
choice_data_list: ...It's such a gentle flame.
...It's such a gentle flame.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: A gentle flame...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. 
It's not as though I'm completely without 
fear, either.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Before we knew it, the world changed 
completely... 
and we lost the sights we once took for 
granted.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The opportunities that should have been 
granted... 
The cheers... The warmth... I'm sure none 
of it 
can ever truly be recovered.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah.
...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Even so. 
If not only the people back home—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If more and more people... 
can find hope in me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If stacking one, then two—then three 
victories together 
can shine a light into everyone's 
hearts...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Then I want to be that flame. 
A flame kindled in everyone's hearts...!
choice_data_list: Daring Tact...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Beyond my hometown... 
I want my flame to reach even further.
choice_data_list: (...That suits her so well.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—A beacon. A small light whose mere 
presence 
brung a soothing warmth... 
Yet carrying undeniable strength to pierce 
the darkness.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I don't expect to be able to save 
everything. 
—Just a single day is enough.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If their hearts can be illuminated for 
just one day... 
I know their lives can keep moving 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Moved by her resolute tenderness, 
before I knew it—the words left my mouth.
choice_data_list: ...Thank you, Daring Tact.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Oh...
choice_data_list: Thanks to you, I can keep looking up too.
Thanks to you, I can keep looking up too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...No. 
I should be the one thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
For giving me my very first step of 
courage— 
thank you so much.
